name: ZeroGPT Pomodoro (PomoNow entry)
description_en:
The assigned PomoNow website currently redirects to ZeroGPT Pomodoro, a browser timer with a task list and separate work, short-break and long-break modes. This profile follows that official entry to its current destination; it does not establish an acquisition, a rebrand date or preservation of an old user account.

The timer is presented as free. Its practical scope is choosing a task, estimating focus intervals and alternating work with breaks. Report and login labels appear in the interface, but their persistence, exports and cross-device behavior were not verified. No task, timer, account or settings change was executed.
description_zh:
本次分配的 PomoNow 官网当前重定向到 ZeroGPT Pomodoro，这是带任务清单、工作、短休息及长休息模式的浏览器计时器。本档案沿官方入口记录当前目标，不据此确立收购、更名日期或旧账户保留。

该计时器宣传免费，实际范围是选择任务、估算专注时段，再交替工作及休息。界面有 Report 和登录标签，但本次未验证持久保存、导出及跨设备行为。没有创建任务、运行计时、注册账户或改变设置。

sections.title_en: Estimate intervals without claiming completed output
sections.title_zh: 估算时段，不把它当作完成产出
sections.en:
For a hypothetical reading session, choose a small outcome such as notes on one section, then estimate two work intervals. The timer instructions use twenty-five minutes per Pomodoro, a five-minute short break and a fifteen-minute long break after four intervals. Two work intervals therefore represent fifty minutes of planned focus, plus breaks; they are not proof of fifty uninterrupted minutes or a finished document.

The documented sequence is add tasks, estimate, select one, start the timer, take the break and mark accomplished work done. This sample was not entered. Decide separately whether the result meets its acceptance condition when the clock ends.
sections.zh:
假设进行阅读，可以选一个小成果，例如一节内容的笔记，再估算两个工作时段。计时器说明采用每次二十五分钟、五分钟短休息，以及四次后十五分钟长休息。因此，两次工作时段表示计划五十分钟专注，另加休息，不证明五十分钟未中断，也不证明文档完成。

文档顺序是添加任务、估算、选定一项、启动计时、休息，再把已完成工作标记完成。本次未输入样例；计时结束后仍需独立判断结果是否满足验收。

sections.title_en: A countdown is a cue, not a verified time record
sections.title_zh: 倒计时是提示，不是已验证工时记录
sections.en:
The public page advertises adjustable work/break durations, background personalization, color changes and audio notifications. Those can support a personal routine, but they do not establish a timesheet, payroll record, team assignment system or reliable billing total. The visible Report label alone does not prove report content or accuracy.

Before relying on an alert, check it under the intended browser/device conditions, including a switched tab, muted sound and an interrupted session. Inspect whether a paused or unfinished interval affects the task estimate and report. These are proposed acceptance checks; no alarm delivery, background timing, report calculation or device test was completed here.
sections.zh:
公开页宣传可调工作／休息时长、背景个性化、颜色变化及声音提醒，可支持个人节奏，但不能据此确立工时表、工资记录、团队分派系统或可靠计费总额。仅有 Report 标签也不证明报告内容或准确性。

依赖提醒前，应按目标浏览器／设备条件检查，包括切换标签页、静音及中断会话，并检查暂停或未完成时段是否影响任务估算及报告。这些是建议验收项，本次未测试声音送达、后台计时、报告计算或设备。

sections.title_en: Keep important tasks somewhere with known persistence
sections.title_zh: 重要任务应有已知持久保存方式
sections.en:
The timer’s About page calls the service completely free, but it also contains unrelated text about password-protected, self-destructing notes and encrypted note delivery. That text is insufficient evidence for how Pomodoro tasks, reports or accounts are stored. No end-to-end-encryption, ISO certification, expiry or self-destruction claim is adopted for timer data.

If a task list matters beyond one session, first inspect what survives reload, sign-out or a different device, and whether an export can be recovered. Until that is demonstrated, retain an independent copy of important task context. The existence of Login/Register does not establish synchronization or account migration from an earlier PomoNow version. No persistence or recovery test was performed.
sections.zh:
计时器 About 页称服务完全免费，但也含密码保护、自毁便笺及加密传递便笺等无关文字，不能用来证明 Pomodoro 任务、报告或账户如何存储。因此，本文不把端到端加密、ISO 认证、过期或自毁主张套用到计时数据。

任务清单若需要跨会话保留，应先检查刷新、退出或更换设备后留下什么，以及导出能否恢复。在演示证明前，应独立保留重要任务上下文。Login／Register 的存在不证明同步，也不证明早期 PomoNow 账户迁移。本次未测试持久保存或恢复。

sections.title_en: Free timer use does not include the parent platform’s paid tools
sections.title_zh: 免费计时不包含母平台付费工具
sections.en:
The free statement belongs to this Pomodoro service. It does not establish free access to ZeroGPT’s other products, APIs or subscriptions. The linked timer Terms route to ZeroGPT’s general service terms, which provide a limited, revocable access license subject to applicable authorization and reserve software/source rights. No open-source or self-host grant was found.

For a person who needs a browser work/break cue and a short session list, the current entry may be worth a small evaluation. A team needing persistent shared projects, audited time, exports or contractual recovery needs further evidence. Exact account conditions, commercial-use scope, retention and regional availability remain unverified. No purchase, plan cancellation, API use or productivity improvement is claimed.
sections.zh:
免费说明属于这项 Pomodoro 服务，不代表免费取得 ZeroGPT 其他产品、API 或订阅。计时器条款链接转到 ZeroGPT 通用服务条款，按适用授权提供有限、可撤销访问许可，保留软件／源码权利；未找到开源或自托管授权。

个人如果只需浏览器工作／休息提示及短时段清单，可做小规模评估。团队若需要持久共享项目、可审计工时、导出或合同恢复，仍需更多证据。具体账户条件、商业使用范围、保留及地区可用性未核实。本次不声称购买、取消方案、API 使用或生产力改善。
